title: Which Pastry Are You?
subtitle: Hare has been watching you. He already knows. Seven questions to find out what Mirai would bake for you.

cheesecake.name: Strawberry Cheesecake
cheesecake.description: Charming, dependable, and the friend everyone can rely on. But somewhere on a shelf, you've put away a dream you once loved. You tell yourself there's no time for it anymore. There is. Someone has been waiting for you to pick it up again, and one slice is enough to start.
cheesecake.bookmark: The moment you stop being yourself is the moment you start losing who you truly are.
cheesecake.chapter: Chapter One · One Slice Is Enough

tart.name: Blueberry Tart
tart.description: Bright on top, a little tart underneath. You feel everything deeply and hold on tightly to the people you love, even the ones who are no longer beside you. Your loyalty is your greatest gift. Just remember that letting new people in isn't the same as letting old ones go.
tart.bookmark: If we always remember those who have left us, did they ever truly leave us?
tart.chapter: Chapter Two · The Half-Eaten Blueberry Tart

millefeuille.name: Mille-Feuille
millefeuille.description: You're everyone's favourite friend: you remember their birthdays, their orders, their bad days. But you show the world only the layer you think it wants. The real you, the one under all those thin, careful layers, is the best part. The people who love you would love that one even more.
millefeuille.bookmark: Don't ever let anyone steal who you are.
millefeuille.chapter: Chapter Three · The Mille-Feuille That Sold Out

creampuff.name: Cream Puff
creampuff.description: Crisp and a little tough on the outside, so nobody gets too close. But inside you're all softness, and you know it, even if you'd never admit it out loud. Kindness is still in you. It always has been. It's just waiting for you to let it out.
creampuff.bookmark: Kindness can be forgotten, but never unlearned.
creampuff.chapter: Chapter Four · One Cream Puff Isn't Enough

eclair.name: Éclair
eclair.nickname: The Perfectionist with a Big Heart
eclair.description: Precise, hard-working, and always measuring twice. You want everything you make to be perfect for the people you love. But somewhere along the way you forgot to taste it yourself. Put down the measuring cup for a moment. It was never about perfect. It was always about who it's for.
eclair.bookmark: Things made with love will always taste right.
eclair.chapter: Chapter Five · A Pinch of Salt

hotchocolate.name: Hot Chocolate with a Pinch of Salt
hotchocolate.description: You're the one people come to when it rains. You notice who's lost before they do, and you always have something warm ready. A little sweetness, a little salt, and just the right balance. Just remember: the one who holds the umbrella deserves shelter too.
hotchocolate.bookmark: Please return the umbrella. Someone else might need their day.
hotchocolate.chapter: The Prologue · Warm Drinks on Rainy Days

questions.q: It's raining and you have nowhere to be. You…
answers: Pull out a notebook and finally write down that idea
Check the group chat to see what everyone else wants to do
Stay in, headphones on, and pretend you're not cold
Reorganise your shelves until they're exactly right
Make a big pot of something warm, in case anyone drops by

questions.q: A grey-and-white cat stares at you, meows once, and walks away. You…
answers: Follow. This feels like the start of a story
Follow, a little nervously, hoping it leads somewhere familiar
Look around to see if anyone else noticed it first
Try to pet it. It swats you. You follow out of spite
Check the time. You have exactly ten minutes. Fine.
Say hello. You have a feeling you two will be friends

questions.q: Your friends would describe you as…
answers: The dreamer with a hundred ideas
Bright, but you feel everything deeply
Easy to get along with, always says the right thing
A bit prickly until they really know you
The one who always has a plan
The one everyone calls when things go wrong

questions.q: Pick an umbrella from the box by the door:
answers: A clear one, so you can watch the rain
Yellow, with a tiny dinosaur on it
Green and brown, plain and sturdy
None. Leave them for someone who needs one more

questions.q: What do you secretly need to hear right now?
answers: "It's not too late to start again."

questions.q: Mirai pours you a drink. What's in the cup?
answers: Jasmine tea, to calm your nerves
Spiced coffee with ginger and cinnamon
Whatever's in the pot, as long as you get to pour for everyone else
Pick the one that looks like it has a story
Choose the one you used to share with someone
Let your friend choose first. You'll have whatever's left
Say you don't like sweets. Then eat two
Buy a whole box for the people waiting at home

scoring: Each answer adds one point to its pastry. Highest total wins. On a tie, the pastry chosen in the latest question among the tied ones wins.
shareText: I'm {name} ({nickname}) from The Blue Bookmark Bookshop. Which pastry are you?
